item.title: John Carlson says there’s ‘no chance’ he’s retiring at season’s end
item.description: John Carlson is in the final season of an eight-year, $64 million contract he signed with the Washington Capitals in 2018. While reportedly there haven’t been any “real” extension talks between the two sides this season, one thing is now completely clear: the soon-to-be 36-year-old rearguard is not hanging up his skates at season’s end.
